subject: devtools::run_examples() not using new S3 documentation rules, as in devtools::document()?

messages.author: 0dd6c9694b3c4809
messages.subject: devtools::run_examples() not using new S3 documentation rules, as in devtools::document()?
parts:
Is run_examples out of synch with the new rules for documenting S3 functions?

I can document my package just fine (love this...)

> devtools::document("~/bin/umx");
Updating umx documentation
Loading umx
Writing NAMESPACE

But run_examples fails on updating the documentation. The error happens on whatever S3 function it first hits, and there's nothing wrong with the roxy, IMHO, apart from it is roxy>v3 style (see below)

devtools::run_examples("~/bin/umx")
Updating umx documentation
Error: Failure in roxygen block beginning fit_and_reporting.r:46
Missing name



example roxygen
#' residuals.MxModel
#'
#' Return the \code{\link{residuals}} from an OpenMx RAM model
#'
#' @rdname residuals.MxModel
#' @param model a (run) \code{\link{mxModel}} to get residuals from
#' @param digits rounding (default = 2)
#' @param suppress smallest deviation to print out (default = NULL = show all)
#' @return - residual correlation matrix
#' @export
#' @family umx reporting functions
#' @references - \url{https://github.com/tbates/umx},
#' @examples
residuals.MxModel <- function(model, digits = 2, suppress = NULL){
  message("testing"
}
